name: A drunk Scots archer
blurb: Far from home, and taking it out on Flanders.

name: A dockside bully at Sluys
blurb: Collects a toll nobody authorised from barges nobody watches.

name: A Watch sergeant on the take
blurb: Paid by the town, and by everyone else as well.

name: Felix de Charetty
blurb: Marian's son and heir, quick-tempered and quicker on his feet. He has been waiting to put Claes on his back.

name: Lopez, the Guinea pilot
blurb: A man with more reason than most to be dangerous, and more sense than most not to show it.

name: Thomas, Astorre's lieutenant
blurb: An Englishman who learned his trade in France and has never forgiven either country.

name: Pagano Doria
blurb: A Genoese with a charming smile and a ship for every occasion. Do not turn your back.

name: Simon de St Pol
blurb: Golden, vain and murderous when slighted. He has every reason, he believes, to wish you dead.

name: Captain Astorre
blurb: He will enjoy it, which is the worrying part.

name: Jordan de Ribérac
blurb: The vicomte de Ribérac: vast, patient and cruel, and Simon's father. Nobody should fight him early. Somebody eventually has to.
